INNOVATION THAT MAKES
EVERY DAY EXTRAORDINARY.
Welcome to your upgrade. Where the mood is upscale, and each new detail adds to the ambi-
ence, for everyone on board. Enjoy the view from an available Dual Panel Moonroof that extends
to the second row, or choose an even more immersive experience, courtesy of the
CrossCabriolet’s fully automatic convertible top. You’ll also appreciate more subtle touches,
such as accent lighting for a warm glow, contrasting wood and metal trims, and the craftsman-
ship of double-stitched leather seating. On the next few pages, you’ll discover all the ways that
Murano makes every drive both purposeful and personal. 2013 Nissan Murano LE shown in Beige Leather with optional equipment.
